diagnosis: Audit log access returns 403 because the account is on a startup plan with basic support, and the kb-0010 article states the audit log feature is only available on standard and premium tiers.
reply:
Thank you for reaching out. The audit log endpoint requires at least a standard support tier, and your current startup plan does not include this feature. This is why calls return a 403 error. You can review the feature availability details in our knowledge base for more information.

I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
